settings.text: Slip the back legs and tail into their sleeves. Walk time.

Most dog raincoats only cover the back, so the rain still soaks the belly and the legs splash through every puddle. Suzeno covers your dog from nose to tail. Snap it on, walk, rinse it off, hang it to dry.

settings.heading: Why it keeps your dog drier

settings.question: What size should I get?
settings.answer: Measure your dog's back length from the base of the collar to the base of the tail, then check the size guide above. Between two sizes, choose the bigger one.

settings.question: Does the face shield bother dogs?
settings.answer: The clear shield sits in front of the face, not on it, so your dog can see normally. Let your dog wear the coat indoors for a few minutes the first time, with a treat.

settings.question: Is it fully waterproof?
settings.answer: The outer fabric sheds rain, and the leg cuffs and tail sleeve close the usual gaps. In very heavy downpours the paws can still get wet.

settings.question: How do I put it on?
settings.answer: Step the front legs in, pull the hood over, close the snap buttons on the chest, then slip the back legs and tail in. It takes under a minute once you've done it twice.

settings.question: How do I clean it?
settings.answer: Rinse it under the tap or hand-wash in cool water with mild soap, then hang it to dry. No tumble dryer.

settings.question: When will my order arrive?
settings.answer: We pack orders within 1–3 business days. You get a tracking link by email as soon as it ships.

settings.question: What if it doesn't fit?
settings.answer: Email support@suzeno.com within 30 days of delivery and we'll help you swap it for another size.
